spec.scope: Generic crit rate (text is unscoped — NOT 'of normal attacks'), so it applies to all her hits incl. burst; only the TRIGGER counts normal attacks.
spec.durationSemantics: durationSec: 10 (wall-clock), refreshed on each re-proc. With MG cadence, 30 hits accrue in ~2-3s, so uptime is near-permanent after the opening wind-up; the buff still must NOT be modeled as passive — the first ~2-3s (wind-up ladder + first 30 hits) are genuinely uncovered.
spec.triggerIdentity: hitCount count:30 (counts ROUNDS; MG hitsPerShot=1 so 1 round = 1 hit), repeating every 30 cumulative hits — NOT one-time, NOT interval, NOT shotFired.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Passive/permanent critRatePct 9.28 from t=0 (or a one-time hitCount that never re-fires), erasing the wind-up-gated ramp-in and the trigger identity; secondary misread: scoping it to critRateNormalPct because the trigger mentions normal attacks.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Collect buffApply events with stat==='critRatePct' && value===9.28 targeting guillotine: assert the FIRST apply lands strictly after her 30th shot event (frame > 0), and that applies recur throughout the fight (count >> 1, refresh:true on re-procs). Red under passive (apply at frame 0) and red under one-shot (single apply). Also assert her burst-bucket damage events carry the buffed crit rate (green under generic critRatePct, red under critRateNormalPct scoping).
spec.inertness: No buffApply of this stat may target any ally slot (targetIdx must be her slot); ally damage totals unchanged when this block is zeroed via withPatchedOverride.

spec.scope: Self HP cost per S1 activation (every 30 hits). It is NOT defensive flavor — it is the ENGINE of the whole kit: the sole HP-loss source in a no-boss-damage sim, feeding skill2's below-70% ATK-per-%-lost scaler and the burst's below-50% second hit.
spec.durationSemantics: Permanent/cumulative — each proc adds 2.01% to lifetime HP lost; nothing in-kit restores it. Steady-state: HP lost accrues ~2.01% per 30 rounds; the below-70% threshold crosses mid-early fight and below-50% mid-fight (exact timing depends on MG effective cadence ⚑).
spec.triggerIdentity: Same hitCount count:30 activation as the crit line (one block, two effects). Expressible as a `resource` effect (e.g. name 'hpLost', delta +2.01, clamped to a floor cap) on that block.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Dropped as 'defensive, no damage impact' (the classic weapon-state/HP-line skip) — which silently kills skill2's ATK scaler AND the burst's second hit, the two biggest levers in the kit.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: withPatchedOverride removing ONLY the HP-loss effect must collapse the downstream consumers: guillotine's total damage drops (ATK scaler never activates) and every burst cast emits exactly ONE 1237.5% hit. Under the shipped model, a late-fight burst cast emits the second hit — green only if HP loss is actually tracked.
spec.inertness: The HP-loss effect itself must emit NO damage event to the boss, no heal, and must not change shots fired, ammo economy, or gauge.

spec.durationSemantics: durationSec: 5 — and UNLIKE skill1 this is a genuinely PARTIAL-uptime buff: 150 rounds between procs takes well over 5s at any plausible MG cadence plus reloads (~1/3-ish duty cycle ⚑ on cadence), so the buff must lapse between procs.
spec.triggerIdentity: hitCount count:150 (rounds), an INDEPENDENT counter from skill1's 30-hit counter — the two blocks must not share accrual.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Passive/permanent critDamagePct 14.69 (over-credits ~3×), or a time-averaged fudge; secondary misread: sharing one hit counter with skill1 (proc at 150 also resetting the 30-counter or vice versa).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: For buffApply events with stat==='critDamagePct' && value===14.69: assert expiresFrame − applyFrame === 300 frames (5s), and the NEXT apply's frame is strictly after the prior expiresFrame (buff has real downtime — no permanent uptime). Also assert applies land at cumulative-shot counts ≈ multiples of 150, interleaved with skill1's 30-hit applies still firing on their own cadence (independent counters).
spec.inertness: No ally receives it; totals of liter/crown/helm unchanged when zeroed.

spec.scope: Self ATK (atkPct, scales own ATK). Activation gate: HP below 70% (i.e. ≥30% lost).
spec.durationSemantics: 'continuously' = live-tracking, not a snapshot: value re-reads current HP lost every frame (perResource shape: mult 0.96 × hpLost pool), growing as S1 drains. NOT durationSec, NOT stacks-with-cap-at-apply.
spec.triggerIdentity: HP-threshold gate — passive perResource self-buff gated on the pool (resourceGate name:'hpLost' min:30). The gate must be evaluated live at read time, not once at t=0 (a passive whose gate is checked only at setup would be permanently OFF).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Two near-misses: (a) ungated scaling from t=0 (credits ~+19% ATK at 20% lost, before the threshold — over-credits the first ~third of the fight); (b) counting only the portion BELOW 70% (value = 0.96×(lost−30)), which under-credits by a flat ~29% ATK for the whole active window. Faithful: zero until lost≥30, then 0.96×TOTAL lost (jumps to ~+28.8% at first activation).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Track guillotine damage events' effective per-hit output (or emitted atkPct buff value if the encoding emits applies): assert ZERO ATK contribution from this line while cumulative HP lost < 30% (early-fight per-shot damage matches a control with this block removed), and at first activation the contribution is ≈ 0.96×30 ≈ 28.8% — not ≈0 (red under below-threshold-only counting) and not present pre-threshold (red under ungated).
spec.inertness: Inert for the entire pre-threshold window; never targets allies; must contribute nothing if the HP-loss effect is removed (composes with the skill1 HP▼ assertion).
spec.evidenceTier: DATAMINED (0.96 magnitude); the activation TIME and steady-state trajectory are CALIBRATED ⚑ (downstream of the ⚑ MG cadence tuple and the ⚑ HP floor)

spec.kitLine: Deals 1237.5% ATK as Burst Skill damage
spec.scope: Single instant hit, % of HER final ATK, burst-damage bucket. Snapshots her live buff state at cast (so a post-threshold cast includes the HP-lost ATK scaler).
spec.durationSemantics: Instant, once per cast; cd 40s bounds cast frequency.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast — fires ONLY on rotations SHE casts, never on the co-B3's (helm's) full bursts. Per the noFb convention, burst-cast instant damage lands PRE-FB-window: no +50% Full Burst major, no range bonus.
spec.targetSet: enemy ('highest final ATK' collapses to the single boss)
spec.nearestWrongModel: Keyed to fullBurstEnter (fires on helm's rotations too in the controlComp — over-credits ~2× on alternating-B3 rotations), and/or taking the +50% FB major on the hit.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Count damage events with bucket burst and mult 1237.5: the count must equal her burstCast event count exactly (not the fullBurstStart count), and each such event must carry fbMajorApplied===false / inFullBurst===false. Red under fullBurstEnter keying (count too high in the helm co-B3 fixture) and red under FB-major application.
spec.inertness: Emits nothing on rotations where helm bursts; no range bonus applied (rangeApplied false).

spec.scope: A SECOND 1237.5% hit on the same target, conditional on HER HP being below 50% at cast time — an HP-gated rider on her own burst, not a separate trigger.
spec.durationSemantics: Instant per qualifying cast; the gate is evaluated per cast against the live pool (hpLost ≥ 50), so early casts are single-hit and post-threshold casts are double.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast + HP gate (resourceGate name:'hpLost' min:50 on the second flatDamage, or an equivalent conditional). Same noFb/no-range/burst-bucket semantics as the first hit.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Unconditional 2475% (or two hits) on every cast — over-credits every pre-threshold burst by 2×; secondary misread: gating on the ENEMY's HP falling below 50% (always/never true vs the immortal boss) instead of the skill user's.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Group burst-bucket 1237.5%-mult damage events by cast frame: her FIRST cast (long before 50% HP lost can accrue at 2.01% per 30 rounds) must contain exactly ONE such hit; a late-fight cast (after the drain crosses 50% lost) must contain exactly TWO. Red under unconditional doubling (first cast has two) and red under a missing/never-true gate (no cast ever has two).
spec.inertness: Absent on every cast while HP lost < 50%; absent entirely if the skill1 HP-loss effect is removed; never fires on helm's rotations.
spec.evidenceTier: DATAMINED (magnitude); the CROSSING TIME is CALIBRATED ⚑ (MG cadence + HP floor)

notes: This kit has NO safely-unmodelable line: the HP ▼ 2.01% cost is the single mechanic every big lever hangs off, and the highest-probability shared-prior misread is dropping it as 'defensive'. Reconciliation points the driver must address: (1) HP-lost bookkeeping — the sim has no HP pool, so the faithful encoding is a named resource pool (drain +2.01 per 30-hit proc) read by a perResource ATK buff and min-thresholded gates at 30/50 lost; if the engine's resourceGate cannot be evaluated live under a passive trigger, that is a GAP to surface, not to paper over. (2) HP FLOOR is kit-silent and MEASUREMENT-GATED ⚑: whether self-drain floors near 0 HP (lost→~99%, ATK scaler →~+95%, second burst hit permanently on late-fight) or stops earlier changes the steady state materially — ship a flagged cap, don't guess silently. (3) Threshold-crossing TIMES are downstream of the ⚑ MG cadence tuple (effective rounds/s incl. wind-up + 171f reloads) — assert orderings (first cast single-hit, late cast double), not exact frames. (4) HEAL INTERACTION GAP: the fixture's B1 (liter) heals in-game, refilling HP and retreating the thresholds, but engine heal effects carry no HP amount — the sim's monotone drain therefore OVER-credits the below-50%/below-70% windows vs a healed real fight; record as a known caveat, not silently. (5) Skill1's 30-hit and skill2's 150-hit counters must accrue independently. (6) The ATK scaler counts TOTAL HP lost once active (~+28.8% at first activation), not only the below-70% portion — assert the jump magnitude at activation.
